result.description:
Network Engineer | Financial services    Your new company     
 Join a high-performing, technology-driven organisation operating in a fast-paced, cloud-first environment where network infrastructure plays a critical role in business success. With ongoing investment into modern networking and cloud capabilities, the business is continuously evolving its platforms to support growth, performance, and security at scale. You'll be part of a collaborative infrastructure team that works closely with engineering groups and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions. 
   Your new role     
 As a Network Engineer, you'll contribute to the ongoing support and enhancement of a complex network environment spanning LAN, WAN, MAN, cloud, and externally facing systems. Working alongside senior engineers, you'll help maintain a stable, high-performing network while also supporting new initiatives and improvements. 
   
 You'll be involved in implementing monitoring and automation to strengthen operational resilience, as well as supporting secure and scalable connectivity across cloud and on-prem platforms. The role offers a balance of BAU responsibilities and project work, giving you exposure to both day-to-day operations and broader infrastructure uplift initiatives. 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Hands-on experience with Cisco and Fortinet technologies across switching, routing, and firewalls (including VDOMs), along with exposure to BGP, VPNs, multicast, and related protocols 
 Experience working in hybrid cloud environments, ideally including AWS (Direct Connect, Transit Gateway) and Azure (ExpressRoute) 
 Background designing and implementing highly available network solutions across multiple connectivity types 
 Exposure to software-defined networking and modern security approaches such as zero trust 
 Around 3-5 years' experience in data networking 
 Exposure to financial services or trading-style environments is beneficial. 
 Familiarity with Linux/Windows servers and tools such as SNMP, Syslog, Datadog, and time synchronisation protocols (NTP/PTP) 
 Experience with network automation and cloud-aligned deployments 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Opportunity to work in a modern, cloud-first environment with ongoing investment in technology 
 Work from home 2 days per week 
 Exposure to complex, enterprise-scale networking across cloud and on-prem infrastructure 
 A collaborative team culture that values continuous learning and improvement 
 The chance to contribute to meaningful projects while building your technical depth across emerging technologies 
 
  What you need to do now         If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV to charlie.pym@hays.com.au   If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.    Please  click here  to apply.
